input.note: DD/FD + HALT (Z80-EXEC-PREFIX-HALT-001). An index prefix in front of an opcode that uses neither H, L nor (HL) is one extra M1; HALT (76) is such an opcode, so DD 76 and FD 76 halt like 76: 8 T (4 for the prefix M1, 4 for the HALT M1), R + 2, PC left on the 76 byte, no displacement fetched and no memory written. FUSE upstream has no dd76/fd76 case (fuse/dd.json jumps from dd75 to dd77), so a regeneration was free to decode it as LD (IX+d),(IX+d) — which the pre-2026-11 core did (19 T, PC + 3, a write to IX+d). The second case gives IX/IY and the would-be displacement byte values that expose that misdecode.
